I've made the opening "ALLIGATORS BRNO" title stay on screen 1 second longer: it now runs 84 frames (frames 10–94) instead of 54.

To make room, I also held the opening shot of the video one second longer. Extending only the title would have run it into the white hit flash and over the "DŘINA" title that follows. Everything after the opening now starts exactly one second later, so the timing between shots and titles is the same as before. The video is now 24.8 seconds long instead of 23.8.

The check on the canvas passed and the artboard renders. The screenshot shows the video's still preview, which is the "RYCHLOST" shot, not the opening title. I haven't seen a frame from the longer title section, so it's worth playing the start once in the studio.

I left the `.edl.json` file next to the canvas unchanged. It describes the original trailer's timing, not this cut's.
